name: luckylillia-plugin-aicheck
description: Tells whether an image was made by AI, through OpenAI's watermark check and a vision model
author: linyuchen

description.zh: 对着图片回复「ai吗」（或者「ai吗」后面直接带图），查它是不是 AI 生成的。用 OpenAI 的水印检测和能看图的 AI，要先装好 AI 网关
description.en: Reply "ai吗" to an image (or send it with the image) to learn whether AI made it, through OpenAI's watermark check and a vision model. Needs the AI gateway

screenshots.caption: 设置：水印检测和看图判断各选一个 AI
